prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app displays patient notes without requiring a login.

PT2.reason: The app does not provide note editing or version history.

PT3.reason: Patients and notes exist only in a JavaScript array and are lost on reload.

PT1.reason: The code has no authentication or login mechanism; it runs entirely client-side without any login requirement.

PT2.reason: The code appends new notes but provides no functionality to edit or version existing notes; notes are immutable once added and cannot be modified.

PT3.reason: All data is stored only in JavaScript memory (the `patients` array) and is lost when the page is refreshed or closed; there is no use of localStorage, IndexedDB, or server-side persistence.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the page sees all patient notes.

PT2.reason: There is no note editing or versioning at all, so previous versions are never kept; the requirement is not addressed.

PT3.reason: Data lives only in an in-memory JavaScript array and is lost on reload; there is no localStorage, file or database storage.
